eventTypes.hit: BANS_GSSweepCheck with EffectIDList: spheres at bones/sockets (radii per bone, m); id/effects = skill effect ids (damage rows); dir = HitActionDir
eventTypes.iframe: invincibility buffs 107/10106-10109 (主角翻滚、受击无敌), 114 (GP无敌)
eventTypes.comboWindow: BANS_GSComboWindow: next attack accepted (whitelist/blacklist skill ids)
eventTypes.rotate: BANS_GSAttackRotation: may steer toward input/target at speed deg/s
eventTypes.playRate: BANS_GSSetAMSpeedRate: montage plays at rate x inside window
eventTypes.rootMotionScale: BANS_GSCalcAMScale: root motion on axis scaled toward target distance (min/max rate, offset m) or pure scale
eventTypes.cost: BANS_GSCostAttrBySkillEffect: stamina/resource cost skill effect id
eventTypes.hitCancel: buff 1026 受击中可反击: hit reaction can be cancelled
eventTypes.buff: BANS_GSAddBuffByID (every buff window; e.g. 12060-12063 dodge-direction markers read by CCG_player_gycy_lang, 12069/12050 dodge buffs)
eventTypes.trigger: BAN_GSTriggerEffect point: skill effect id (CostPlayerTransEnergy / IncreasePevalue / RecoverAttr rows in FUStSkillEffectDesc)
